findings.locator: §9.1 Table 9 (Q12 示範狀態碼 column) and §10.4 Table 16 (30天 column), conflicting with §3.1 and §8.2 Table 7
findings.finding: Wave-1 Q12 synthetic data records completed certification attempts for all eight wave-1 respondents (six code 1 met, two code 2 not met; Table 16 shows 6/8 = 75.0% and 2/8 = 25.0% as 30-day results), but the register dates every attempt 2026-07-10 — day 56 after the stated Day-0 2026-05-15 — while wave-1 collection closes day 40 (2026-06-24) and §3.1 states the 30-day wave only covers initial exam-preparation status (初期證照備考狀態). No earlier attempt is documented, so the wave-1 Q12 statuses and their per-wave summary are chronologically impossible on the document's own timeline; the document's own rule that the two waves are judged separately is violated for the certification column (wave-2 Q12 codes 1/4 are consistent because they are post-exam).
findings.required_action: Smallest fix preserving all reconciliations and the 8/10, 6/8, 6/10 calculations: recast wave-1 Q12 statuses as pre-exam states (e.g., all eight as code 3 已報名待考， or a defensible registration/deferred mix), update Table 9's Q12 column and Table 16's 30-day column with a one-line note that final met/not-met statuses are reported only in the 90-day wave and register; alternatively move the demonstration exam date on/before 2026-06-24 and reconcile §3.1's wave-1 wording. Then rebuild the DOCX and re-submit the new exact SHA for semantic review.
